challenges.text: Dying declaration was recorded after significant delay - possibility of tutoring
Injuries could be accidental - kitchen fire accidents are common
No independent witness to alleged cruelty or harassment
Parents of deceased are interested witnesses - testimony biased
Death occurred after 7 years of marriage - 304B presumption does not apply
Victim had history of depression - suicide possibility not investigated
Demand letters recovered but handwriting analysis not conducted
Medical evidence shows burn pattern consistent with accident, not assault
